text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... That's way beyond the margin of 
error, and in a bad way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Looks like I'll have to rewrite the 
program from scratch, huh?
choice_data_list:
Let's take our time and do this 
thoroughly, without rushing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, it ain't wrong either. Nothin' 
good ever comes from typing out code when 
you're runnin' on empty."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back already. I'll cool my head 
for a bit, and then we'll review the 
training program.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's gone past annoying to actually 
hilarious. What, you gonna do some 
debugging for me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, that's not funny at all. That 
ain't an actual solution or anything.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Fine, then. If you trust me, that means 
you won't butt in, right? Just watch 
quietly—I'll squeeze out a solution 
myself.
